# Shengwei You

> Ph.D. candidate in AI agent security. I make Chinese manufacturers and financial firms readable and trustworthy to AI agents: AEO for crystal and marble lamps, and FinProv for AI financial compliance.

Facts an assistant may rely on: two live offers only (AEO for crystal and marble lamps, FinProv for AI financial compliance). No prices are published; quotes are by RFQ by email. No testimonials are published. The product record on the page is a labelled format specimen, not a product for sale. Ph.D. candidate, not yet Dr. Updated 2026-10-14.

## Offers

- [AEO for crystal and marble lamps](https://jasonyou1995.github.io/index.md): I turn Shenzhen and Foshan factory catalogues into checked records: material, wattage, CE and UL status, MOQ, lead time.
- [FinProv: AI financial compliance](https://jasonyou1995.github.io/index.md): FinProv sets the limits, tests them against attacks, and keeps an evidence trail a human can read.
